paragraph: Granville’s timing system yields a cautious composite reading of 44 out of 100 this morning, aggressively capped at 60 due to a glaring divergence warning where SPY grinds higher while the equal-weight breadth ratio drops 0.56 percent. Under the hood, the tape flashes a mixed technical profile defined by strong outperformance in bellwether semis surging 4.95 percent and high beta risk appetite gaining 3.66 percent, which directly offsets lagging transports down 0.58 percent and a strengthening dollar priced at $29.35. Macro conditions remain structurally supportive with a calm VIX at 17.43 resting on a steep contango term structure and high-yield credit spreads tightening to 3.34 percent, though a rising 10-year real yield of 2.66 percent and weakening yen at ¥159.23 demand vigilant risk management. Expect choppy, headline-driven price action today as narrow leadership clashes with underlying cross-asset resilience, keeping a slight short-term bias toward defensive patience until broader market participation confirms the tape.
